messages.text: Look, Mouse found a horse. Listen first. It's a horse. Your turn. It's a horse.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Yes, it's a horse. Who has the cake? Say cow, cat, or horse.[TEACHER_APPLAUD][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Good guess. Let's watch and find out.[TEACHER_POINT_TO_SCREEN][NEXT_STEP]
